caption: The drawing depicts a single ice skate viewed from the side, featuring a wooden base that is light brown in color. Attached to the wooden base are two tan-colored leather straps with black metal buckles, designed to secure the skate to the foot. The leather straps loop upward, each passing through a buckle to allow adjustment. Toward the rear, an iron blade runs along the underside of the wooden base, curving upward at the back into a large circular loop. At the front of the wooden platform, a single metal screw protrudes vertically. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. Near the lower right corner, a scale marked in inches and a name ("S.C. Klenk") is visible, along with fine lines indicating measurement units.
title: Ice Skate
